scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @libra/shared" "npm run dev -w @libra/server" "npm run dev -w @libra/client"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @libra/client && npm run build -w @libra/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @libra/shared && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
